assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 3:2 game home background, 1536x1024 landscape. Create an exquisite cozy cyberpunk desktop-pet room as a compact cutaway diorama viewed almost straight-on with a gentle isometric perspective, an intimate futuristic apartment for a tiny whale-themed digital companion. A wide rain-streaked window with a distant neon city, a small rounded bed on the right, a luminous little aquarium and potted plants, a compact workstation on the left, subtle whale motifs, warm amber desk lamps amid deep navy, teal, emerald and restrained pink-purple neon. Premium hand-painted game environment with crisp readable silhouettes, layered atmospheric light and tasteful lived-in detail, not photographic, not pixel art. COMPOSITION: spacious empty dark floor in the center foreground for separately composited pet sprite, furniture along sides and back. Keep the upper 15 percent subdued for UI overlay. No character or person anywhere, no fish creature, no words or letters, no UI panels, no borders, no watermark. Full bleed horizontal scene with strong but controlled cinematic lighting. Whimsical and reassuring rather than dystopian. Original artwork.
